answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint throwaway graders to farm panel weight. Mechanism: each agent must climb a jade ledge protocol—lock 0.11 POA for 40 hours, then publish three river-timed work receipts at minutes 0/25/55 hashed as H(pubkey||slot||tip); weight unlocks only after five non-kin peers countersign all three with ≥12-minute spacing.
